items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: we would take pieces like Star Dust that was written by Hogie Carmichael

ctx.x: In other words we would take pieces like Star Dust that was written by Hogie Carmichael, and very famous, and we would play the melody just long enough for you to know that we were playing 'Star Dust', and then we would start playing our ad lib versions and rhythmic conceptions of this piece. In our way these were known as jam sessions, like jam, you know, j-a-m.
